purpose: The Ledger Service provides an authoritative, secure record of all financial transactions across the platform, ensuring consistency in account balances and auditability of financial movements.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: ledger-core checks that each entry balances, stores it in ledger-db (PostgreSQL) and announces it on ledger-events (Kafka).

flows.evidence: Wallet and payment services send journal entries to ledger-core.
Other teams subscribe to those announcements, for example notifications and analytics.
